message.content:
Major critics of Copernicus included Church censors such as Pope Pius V and later Cardinal Robert Bellarmine.
Philosophers and astronomers also objected, especially those who trusted Aristotelian physics and Ptolemaic astronomy, such as Tycho Brahe and Christoph Clavius.
Did the Church condemn Copernicus himself during his lifetime?
Which critics were more influential, the theologians or the natural philosophers?
The geocentric opponents were fierce!
The idea of a moving Earth was shocking!
